summary: Expand sequential bind clauses into nested flatMap calls and bind each captured name in the remaining clauses.

capabilities.requirement: Support the do-notation surface from the playground.
Let a macro author define a reusable bind-clause syntax class.
Expose the bind name and source expression as typed fields.
Consume the source and final result as complete TypeScript expressions.
Bind each clause name in later clauses and the final result without capturing outer names.
Expand one bind clause and recurse on the remaining block.

syntaxNotes: A semicolon terminates each bind clause and the final return clause.
The left arrow belongs to the bind-clause syntax class rather than the global operator table.
The final clause uses return so the block has one visible completion form.

openDecisions.question: Use dot notation for fields exported by user syntax classes?
